::: {.tldr}
By the end of your second week you should: (1) have all your accounts set up,
(2) have completed CITI human subjects training, (3) be listed on at least one
IRB-on-record at your hub, (4) have Cryptomator working on your laptop, and
(5) have read your project's pre-analysis plan.
:::

## Week 1

### Day 1
- Read the [Working at IE](/working-at-ie/index.qmd) overview for your hub.
- Set up your IE email signature ([template](/working-at-ie/email-signature.qmd)).
- Complete [CITI Human Subjects Certification](/research-design/irbs.qmd#citi-training).

### Days 2–3
- Read your project's pre-analysis plan and the underlying registered trial on
  the [AEA Registry]({{< meta var.aea-registry >}}).
- Skim [J-PAL's introduction to randomized evaluations]({{< meta var.jpal-research-resources >}}#introduction)
  if you're new to the methodology.

### Days 4–5
- Set up [Cryptomator](/research-design/cryptomator.qmd) on your laptop.
- Get your name added to relevant project IRBs ([how](/research-design/irbs.qmd#getting-added)).
- Meet your project's RM and ask about the team's weekly rituals.

## Week 2

- Shadow at least one survey or partner call.
- Read [File and Folder Management](/research-design/file-and-folder-management.qmd)
  and conform your local setup to it.
- **Submit your first handbook contribution** — see
  [Contributing](/contributing.qmd). Even a typo fix counts.

## Hub-specific add-ons

::: {.panel-tabset}
## YIE
- Set up your Yale NetID and VPN.
- Review the [YIE Time Off Request Policy](/working-at-ie/yie-time-off.qmd).
- Read [Yale Travel Expense Guidance](/working-at-ie/yale-travel-expense.qmd).

## IEIC
- IFMR HR onboarding (separate process).
- Review [Research Manager Responsibilities](/working-at-ie/ieic-rm-responsibilities.qmd).
- Complete [Digital Signature Training](/working-at-ie/digital-signature.qmd).

## IEN
- Governance Lab orientation.
- Read [Working at IEN](/working-at-ie/working-at-ien.qmd).
:::

::: {.who-to-ask}
Your hub's Research Manager. They sign you off on this checklist.
:::
